title: Central Government's Power to Prescribe Value for National Commission

content.scenario: The Central Government deems it necessary to reduce the jurisdictional limit of the National Commission due to a high volume of complaints. It prescribes a new value of Rs. 5 crores, lower than the original limit of ten crore rupees.
content.outcome: The Central Government's prescription of the new value is valid as it is deemed necessary, and the National Commission shall entertain complaints where the value of goods or services paid as consideration exceeds the newly prescribed value.

user_queries: What is the jurisdictional limit of the National Commission?
Can the Central Government change the jurisdictional limit?
What happens if the Central Government prescribes a new value?
